thread:
maya: quick heads-up — the Python quickstart README still shows the old manual Authorization header + requests example. that trips people up when they try to copy/paste our examples into prod.
sam_k: ugh, thanks for catching. is it the one under examples/quickstart/README.md? we should swap to the official SDK usage and show how to override retry config.
maya: yep that one. current snippet looks like:
```python
import requests
API_KEY = "<YOUR_API_KEY>"
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"}, json={"prompt": "hi"})
print(resp.json())
```

maya: recommend replacing with this (SDK v0.5+):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
from redwood.retry import RetryConfig

client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
retry = RetryConfig(max_attempts=3, backoff_multiplier=2.0)
response = client.generate(prompt="Write a short poem about caching.", retry=retry)
print(response.text)
```

olivia_docs: perfect — also add a one-liner explaining why env var vs inline key (security). can you open a PR and include a small smoke test for the example? :thumbsup:

maya: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/189 — includes commit to swap snippet, add note about REDWOOD_API_KEY, and a CI smoke script that runs the example with a fake local mock.

leo_g: quick q: env var name is REDWOOD_API_KEY? i thought the SDK would also pick up gcloud/azure creds automatically in private deployments.
sam_k: SDK picks up default credential chain for private deployments, but for quickstarts we recommend REDWOOD_API_KEY to keep it simple. good call to call that out in the README.
docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #189 is available: https://deploy.previews.redwood-inference/examples/189 — includes rendered README and snippet check (ci/examples-smoke).
sam_k: assigning review to @olivia_docs. adding a small docs-lint to flag direct Authorization headers in examples (catch copy/paste drift).
olivia_docs: noted — i'll review PR today and add the copy note about retry defaults + how to override. also adding a short troubleshooting blurb: "If you see 401s after copying, check that you didn't paste an expired key or inline Authorization header."
maya: pushed a tiny follow-up to that PR with the blurb and fixed spacing in the code block. thanks all. :rocket:
sam_k: can we also add a CONTRIBUTING.md snippet that instructs maintainers to run the smoke script before merging? fewer regressions that way.
olivia_docs: done — added to PR as a second commit. filing a separate issue to enable a docs check in CI to run the examples smoke tests on edits. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/457
leo_g: nice, this will reduce onboarding friction a lot.
maya: thanks — closing the loop. if anyone spots more copy/paste spots, drop them in #devex or ping me.
